alerts.confirmPickupBody: Only confirm after you have reviewed all photos and agree with the odometer, fuel level and damage recorded in the report.
alerts.revisionRequested: Revision requested. Waiting for the owner to send a new report.
alerts.paymentReturn: After paying, return to the app and tap check payment or reload the booking.
alerts.paymentIncomplete: Payment is not complete yet. You can check again later.
alerts.reportSent: Report submitted. Waiting for the customer to confirm.
alerts.checkoutConfirmed: Return confirmed. Waiting for the owner to confirm receipt of the vehicle.

hero.timezoneHint: Times are shown in Vietnam time (UTC+07:00).

approve.title: Booking request awaiting approval
approve.subtitle: Respond early so the customer can pay the deposit
approve.approved: Booking approved. Waiting for the customer to pay the deposit.

deposit.title: Deposit payment
deposit.subtitle: The owner approved the booking request
deposit.noticeBody: The owner has approved. Please pay the deposit before picking up the vehicle.

inspection.actionsSubtitle: Review the report, vehicle photos and payments before confirming
inspection.contractNote: Both owner and customer must sign the contract before pickup can be confirmed. You can sign on the web if you have not done so.
inspection.acceptCheckIn: Agree to the report and pick up
inspection.acceptCheckOut: Agree to the report and return
inspection.checkoutDisagreeHint: If you disagree, talk to the owner or contact support before confirming.
inspection.revisionHint: Describe exactly what needs fixing. The trip only starts once you agree to the new report.
inspection.earlyPickupAvailable: Vehicle is free: you can check in up to 2 hours early. Return time and rental price stay as booked.
inspection.earlyPickupFallback: You can check in up to 2 hours early if the vehicle is free. Reload the booking to check.
inspection.waitingPickupReport: Waiting for the owner to take photos and create the pickup report.
inspection.waitingReturnReport: On return, the owner will take photos and create a report for you to check.

cancel.title: Cancel booking
cancel.subtitle: Review the deposit refund policy before cancelling

next.approve: Tap “Approve booking” so the customer can pay the deposit.
next.waitApproval: Waiting for the owner to approve the booking request.
next.waitDeposit: Waiting for the customer to pay the deposit.
next.waitDepositExpired: The deposit deadline has passed. Wait for the system to process it or contact the owner.
next.createCheckIn: Tap “Create check-in report” when handing over the vehicle.
next.waitPickup: Waiting for the pickup time. Reload to check early pickup availability.
next.waitPickupReport: Waiting for the owner to take photos and create the pickup report.
next.confirmCheckIn: Review the report, then tap “Agree to the report and pick up”.
next.requestCheckInRevision: If the report is wrong, tap “Request revision”.
next.reportNoShow: You have not picked up the vehicle. Tap report no-show if you no longer need it.
next.waitCheckInConfirm: Waiting for the customer to review and confirm the pickup report.
next.waitCheckInRevision: Waiting for the owner to send a new pickup report.
next.waitStart: Pickup confirmed. The trip will start as scheduled.
next.renting: The vehicle is being rented. Track the trip progress below.
next.reportReturn: When returning the vehicle, create the return report to compare.
next.createCheckOut: Tap “Create check-out report” when you get the vehicle back.
next.waitCheckOutConfirm: Waiting for the customer to review and confirm the return report.
next.confirmCheckOut: Review the report, then tap “Agree to the report and return”.
next.disputeCheckOut: If the report is wrong, tap “Request revision” before confirming.
next.waitReturnReport: Waiting for the owner to take photos and create the return report.
next.waitReturnFinish: Waiting for the system to close the return.
next.waitOwnerReceipt: Waiting for the owner to confirm receipt of the vehicle.
next.confirmReceipt: Tap “Confirm receipt” to close the return.
next.paySurcharge: Pay the outstanding surcharge to finish the booking.
next.settle: Tap “Release deposit” to receive the deposit.
next.settleHold: The deposit is held for reconciliation, about {{hours}} hours left. Then tap “Release deposit”.
next.done: The booking is complete, no further action needed.
next.default: Reload the booking to see the next step.
